summary_i18n.en: Money for fees and living costs for Scheduled Caste and Navbouddha students studying after Class 10.

source_title: Government of India Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme, Social Justice and Special Assistance Department, Maharashtra (page updated 25.04.2025)

label_i18n.en: Parents' yearly income is Rs 2.5 lakh or less

note_i18n.en: Apply on the MahaDBT portal. Ask the Social Justice office which papers to bring.

research_note: READ in full on 2026-11-19 (page fetched): category SC or Navbouddha, above 10th standard, Maharashtra resident, parent income up to Rs 2.50 lakh for the full scholarship; apply on MahaDBT; start date 01/11/2003, no end date. The page lists no documents. Reports that the central income limit may rise to Rs 4.5 lakh are a plan, not a notified rule, so they are not used.
